accueil.titre_seo: Romane Chaslin — Photographer in Rennes, France

regard.texte: I’ve been passionate about photography for years, and I love taking on challenges and venturing into all kinds of fields. Concerts, weddings, street or travel photography: it’s the variety of projects that inspires and drives me. Whether I’m shooting on film or with the latest digital camera, the goal behind my images is always the same: capturing the moment that makes the difference.

paragraphes: I got my first camera at 14, and it hasn’t left my side since. Over the years, I’ve explored all kinds of landscapes and captured moments that seem suspended in time. Every image tells a story, whether it’s that bear in Canada, that loving gaze or that singer playing the last show of a tour.

about.titre_seo: About — Romane Chaslin, photographer in Rennes, France
about.description: Who is Romane Chaslin? A photographer based in Rennes, France, passionate since the age of 14, working on film and digital.
paragraphes: I’m Romane Chaslin, the eye behind all these photos. For years, I’ve been fascinated by the way light, shadows, lines and symmetry can shape a picture.
Along the way, I studied communication and marketing up to master’s level, lived in Canada for a year and held several positions at major French media outlets.

And even though I love my job, it’s always the passion for creating and imagining that inspires me most. Every time I shoot, the challenge is to bring out emotion, beauty and authenticity in every place and every person.
about.conclusion: So if you’d like to tell me about a project, let’s talk right here!
